title: Bound and control-filter retained verification refusal messages
outcome: Refusal diagnostics retain a bounded useful message and prevent terminal control sequences in displayed summary text.
acceptance: Define and apply a byte bound and control-character policy to retained remote refusal messages without losing the typed refusal code or terminal semantics.
Cover C0/C1 controls and long multibyte messages through retained detail and displayed summary tests.
disposal_reason: Continue as independent work after parent implementation landed and completed; optional review Low remains tracked with quoted provenance.
